    ]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df_melted = df.melt(id_vars="Quarter", var_name="Program", value_name="Budget Allocation (Million USD)")

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

palette = sns.color_palette(["#4E79A7", "#F28E2B", "#E15759", "#76B7B2", "#59A14F", "#EDC948"])

area_chart = sns.lineplot(
    data=df_melted,
    x="Quarter",
    y="Budget Allocation (Million USD)",
    hue="Program",
    palette=palette,
    linewidth=2.5,
    sort=False
)

plt.stackplot(
    df["Quarter"],
    df[["Sustainable Agroforestry", "Community Health Clinics", "Rural Infrastructure",
        "Education Initiatives", "Clean Water Systems", "Women's Empowerment"]].T,
    labels=df_melted["Program"].unique(),
    colors=palette,
    alpha=0.7
)

plt.title("Global Aid Program Budget Allocation Over Time (2022-2024)", fontsize=16, pad=20)

plt.legend(title="Program", bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("output.png")

SUMMARY
 The image is a stacked area chart titled "Global Aid Program Budget Allocation Over Time (2022-2024)," illustrating how funding for various aid programs has been distributed across different quarters from 2022 to 2024. The chart uses a vertical axis labeled "Budget Allocation (Million USD)" to represent the financial allocation, ranging from 0 to 90 million USD, while the horizontal axis is labeled "Quarter" and spans from 2022-Q1 to 2024-Q4.

Six distinct aid programs are represented, each assigned a unique color for clarity. At the bottom of the stack, the "Sustainable Agroforestry" program is shown in blue, with allocations starting at approximately 12.5 million USD in 2022-Q1 and gradually increasing to around 15.8 million USD by 2024-Q4. Directly above it, in orange, is the "Community Health Clinics" program, which grows from about 10.2 million USD in 2022-Q1 to roughly 14.5 million USD by the end of the period.

The "Rural Infrastructure" program, depicted in red, occupies a significant portion of the chart, starting at 18.3 million USD in 2022-Q1 and rising to 25.5 million USD in 2024-Q4. Above this, the "Education Initiatives" program, shown in teal, begins at 7.5 million USD and increases steadily to 10.3 million USD. The "Clean Water Systems" program, represented in green, starts at 14 million USD and reaches approximately 17.8 million USD by 2024-Q4. Finally, the "Women's Empowerment" program, displayed in yellow at the top, begins with an allocation of 6.8 million USD and grows to 9.2 million USD over the observed period.

The chart effectively highlights the cumulative budget allocation trends for each program, showing how the total funding across all programs grows over time, peaking in 2024-Q3 before experiencing a slight decline in 2024-Q4. The stacked nature of the chart allows for easy comparison of both individual program growth and the overall budget distribution.
